key_point: The Oregon Trail almost disappeared forever
title: The Oregon Trail almost disappeared forever
caption: The Oregon Trail was made in 1971 by a student teacher for his history class. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #oregontrail #mecc

instagram.caption:
The Oregon Trail began in 1971 when student teacher Don Rawitsch wanted to make his 8th grade history class more exciting.

With two fellow student teachers, he built it on a school teletype. When the term ended, he deleted it, keeping only a printed copy of the code.

In 1974 he typed it back in for MECC, and it went on to teach generations of kids. All thanks to a sheet of paper.

Did you die of dysentery?
